cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I've found our wedding video. Shall we watch it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather discuss why we're living separately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Here's your father's speech. We never could agree what he meant by 'good luck'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He meant exactly this. Pause it. I don't want another speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paused. Let's skip to the dancing, then. No speeches. You can help me settle whether your uncle actually falls into the cake.

mechanism: A controls permission to pause and change the video topic, granting only entertainment choices that avoid discussing the separation.
confusable: D62 avoids legitimacy questions; D86 avoids the actual cause of relationship change.
comparison: Wedding-video playback control differs from shifting a picnic conversation between physical space and food.
seedUse: Use D86-b no-speeches request as the reason A substitutes dancing, without treating that concession as answering the separation question.
